selection: pre-training group-only, label-coverage stratified; no prediction metrics consulted
test_policy: evaluate once after candidate selection using val only
grouping_limits: Directory families and visual candidate relations are conservative engineering groups; not verified independent capture identities. Z8-assisted human review is not blind ground truth.
notes: Splits were frozen before training; test was opened once after validation-only candidate selection.
Grouping is an engineering anti-leakage approximation, not verified photographer or capture-event identity.
Labels are Z8-assisted human corrections, not independent blind annotation, and are bound to the frozen 384 x 256 input.
